newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Two firms cut Apple rating.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Two firms cut Apple rating.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers and Goldman Sachs said on Thursday they had cut their ratings for Apple Computer Inc, and CS First Boston kept its rating of hold for the troubled computer maker.
-- First Boston widened its forecast for Apple's 1997 loss per share to $2 from $1.75.
-- Lehman cut its rating to neutral from outperform and Goldman reduced it to market perform from its recommended list.
-- "We are lowering FY97 estimates from a recently reduced $0.67 to a loss of $1.90, with profits not expected" until the fourth quarter, Lehman analyst Kimberly Alexy wrote in a report.
-- "While we expect that further downside risk is limited with cash ... at approximately $10 a share, we find no remaining fundamental reasons to continue to support the stock."
-- The company's shares were off 1/4 to 17.
